name: Mister Average
source:
A story about Daniel, a schoolboy in the New England town of Arkham who just wants to be average and fit in with everybody else—but in a calculatingly manipulative way. How things fit is very important to him.

And things that are out of place bother him. A lot.

Unfortunately, this is Arkham, where the unusual is the norm ...

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=22368]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于丹尼尔的故事，他是新英格兰小镇阿卡姆的一名男学生，他只想成为一个平庸的人，与其他人打成一片，但以一种精于算计的方式进行操纵。事情如何适合对他来说非常重要。

不合时宜的事情会让他烦恼。很多。

不幸的是，这里是阿卡姆，不寻常就是常态……

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=22368]引理软论坛[/url]]
